tasks.summary: Elemental Endurance was consolidated into a copy-paste-friendly candidate. It is not a GDD decision: same-school resistance, its feedback, damage-event counting, and all active Enemy behavior remain unresolved.

recovery.role: Own player-facing combat-design discussion without promoting candidates into canonical gameplay.
decisions_and_rationale: Existing prototype authority remains the current GAME_DESIGN.md: target enemies are non-attacking and active Enemy AI is excluded.
No Elemental Endurance rule is accepted into GAME_DESIGN.md; the discussion is a candidate intended to make school switching and mixed Casting meaningful before a later boss-like test.
proposals: Same-school hits 1–5 deal 100%; hit 6 deals 50% and enables a school-colored protective icon; hits 7–9 decrease; hit 10+ deals 0% until another school lands.
A different-school hit clears the previous streak and buff; a mixed-school Cast resets the endurance counter, clears the buff, and applies both damage layers at full damage.
The icon’s lower-right number would show remaining damage percentage from 50 down to 0.
open_questions: What counts as one endurance hit when one spell produces multiple damage events.
Whether damage numbers represent actual post-resistance, post-blocking, post-modifier Health loss.
Enemy movement, attacks, perception, and all other active AI behavior.
conflicts: The candidate is absent from canonical gameplay records and must not be implemented or treated as verified merely because the task has a copy-paste artifact.
validation_limits: No Enemy-AI or Elemental Endurance runtime validation exists. Existing user-reported Stage 1–6 validation is broad only; no agent-run Godot, build, compiler, or automated-test evidence exists.
recovery.resume_point: If design resumes, resolve one open interaction at a time—most immediately how multi-event spell damage counts—before any technical handoff.
